# Output Standard Comparison Sample

> **TL;DR:** Comparison pages use a table by default. HTML render is opt-in.

## Overview

A comparison page lines up two or more options.

Use a Markdown table when HTML is off.

Set html_render to true only for hands-on exploration.

## Comparison

| Content type | Format | Rung | Policy |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exact procedure | STE text | 1 | default |
| Relationships | Mermaid plus text | 2 | default |
| Comparison | HTML page | 3 | opt-in |
| Concept from zero | Video | 4 | out of scope |

Formats stack. HTML is always opt-in. Video is outside the current scope.
